text:
Alex W: quick intake for marlin-7b (dev/staging). can someone run a couple sanity checks before we promote to dedicated? checklist below.

Priya S: sure. what's on the checklist?

Alex W: 1) basic tokenization + end-of-sequence handling
2) short prompt correctness (1-3 shot)
3) long-context behavior (~2k tokens) - ensure no OOM
4) quantized int8 output parity vs fp16 (spot check)
5) streaming & chunked generation
6) perf numbers: p50/p95 latency on dev-stg

Sam T: I'll run tokenization + short prompts. hitting it now. curl example:
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://dev-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"marlin-7b","input":"Translate to French: Hello"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for model marlin-7b@v0.1 -> dev-staging (node pool: gpu-small)

Sam T: tokenization looks fine, EOS handled, short prompt -> "Bonjour" good. attaching one failing case: multi-turn role labels confused system.

Marta G: I'll take long-context and quant checks. running int8 vs fp16 sample set (10 prompts) now. eval-bot: scheduled eval job eval-38921 (marlin-7b) queued.

Priya S: FYI noticed subtle degenerate repetition at 1200 tokens on fp16 too. filing quick ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ML-1234

Marta G: int8 parity ~92% on exact-match for code-style prompts, but few hallucinations on knowledge prompts. attaching logs: /logs/marlin7b/2025-10-07

Alex W: good notes. follow-ups: (a) add prefix caching test (b) run 1000-sample eval with eval harness (c) try tiny-batched streaming to measure p95. Who can own next steps?

Priya S: I'll own prefix-caching and p95 runs.

Sam T: I'll add a short prompt suite to the onboarding repo and update model meta with known regressions.

Alex W: thanks team. marking dev-staging gate as "manual-qa-pending" until PRs + eval report. :thumbsup:
